newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil transvestite dies after being set on fire.
newsitem.headline: Brazil transvestite dies after being set on fire.

text.p: A transvestite who was doused with gasoline and set on fire by a 16-year-old girl eight days ago died in the southeastern city of Belo Horizonte, hospital officials said Tuesday.

Renato Eustaquo de Jesus, 31, died Monday at Joao XXIII Hospital from burns suffered in the June 2 attack. He was the third person since mid-April to die after being deliberately set on fire in Brazil.
According to news reports, the girl, whose name was not released, was alleged to have doused de Jesus with gasoline and set him on fire with a lighter after the two argued over $20.
The girl was taken to a youth detention centre.
